subject.title: Feishu: benign non-zero exec exit codes render as "Exec failed" in tool-progress and interrupt streaming; no per-channel toolProgress toggle

question: Should Feishu adopt the shared nested preview streaming policy, and should any Feishu streaming visibility key become agent-tunable through `gateway config.patch`?
rationale: The remaining fix changes public channel configuration and possibly the model-to-operator config mutation boundary, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Adopt Feishu nested preview policy
options.body: Extend Feishu to support the shared `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText` contract with current defaults preserved and any shipped boolean-shape migration handled through doctor.

options.title: Keep boolean-only Feishu streaming
options.body: Limit the response to wording/classification changes and document the manual workaround, leaving users without a way to keep Feishu streaming while hiding progress lines.

options.title: Add a coarse gateway toggle
options.body: Allow a narrow `config.patch` path for Feishu preview visibility, which improves recovery but needs explicit security review because it broadens persistent config mutation.

recommendation.title: Adopt Feishu nested preview policy
recommendation.body: Extend Feishu to support the shared `streaming.preview.toolProgress` and `streaming.preview.commandText` contract with current defaults preserved and any shipped boolean-shape migration handled through doctor.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main blame and recent shared/Feishu streaming work make this the strongest available routing signal for the config and channel-runtime decision.
